# Maurice Kleine

> Personal site of Maurice Kleine: Amsterdam-based AI engineer and indie hacker. AI Engineering Lead at Waimakers by day, builder of small internet things after dinner. Built in public; agents are welcome to read, quote, and train on it.

A TanStack Start app on Cloudflare Workers, prerendered to plain HTML. Markdown mirrors of every page exist for easier parsing, and there's a small static JSON API because why not.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.mauricekleine.com/index.md): Who Maurice is, what he's building now, and the graveyard of ended experiments
- [About](https://www.mauricekleine.com/about.md): The longer story, community work, and philosophy
- [Essays](https://www.mauricekleine.com/essays.md): Longer thoughts first posted on X and LinkedIn, each with its own .md twin
- [Superthread](https://superthread.mauricekleine.com/): Design tokens, components, and the public specimen for Maurice's fleet, on its own site

## Essays

- [Ride the Floor Up](https://www.mauricekleine.com/essays/ride-the-floor-up.md): AI raises the floor of what technology does for us. How to keep raising your own ceiling while it does.
- [The Journey No Longer Matters](https://www.mauricekleine.com/essays/the-journey-no-longer-matters.md): Fifteen years of loving the craft of building software. What happens when the craft stops being the point.
- [My agents merged 468 PRs in 23 days. I didn't read a single one of them.](https://www.mauricekleine.com/essays/my-agents-merged-468-prs.md): How Hyperspeed runs my coding agents overnight, and why planning and validation are the job now.
- [Dude, where is the ROI?](https://www.mauricekleine.com/essays/dude-where-is-the-roi.md): You followed every step of the AI hype cycle. So where is the return? On tinkering versus shipping.

## Side quests

- [Mockly](https://www.getmockly.com): Fake chat screenshots for 17+ platforms. Built it in a weekend, TechCrunch wrote about it, 10k people use it. I can't believe this is legal. (with Jasper de Boer)
- [Fluncle](https://www.fluncle.com): Drum & bass bangers from another dimension. It has a radio, an API, and an SSH rave terminal.
- [Hackadam](https://hackadam.nl): Monthly meetup in Amsterdam for indie makers building their own stuff. (with Abner van den Hout)
- [Nonobench](https://www.nonobench.com): Benchmark for how well LLMs solve nonogram puzzles. The top score went from 63% in February to 93% in September.

## Feed

- [Essays feed](https://www.mauricekleine.com/feed.xml): Atom feed of new essays

## MCP

- [MCP server](https://www.mauricekleine.com/mcp): Streamable HTTP, no auth. Tools: about_maurice, list_projects, list_essays, get_essay, get_uptime, make_a_wish
- [Server card](https://www.mauricekleine.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Discovery metadata
- [Agent skills](https://www.mauricekleine.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Skills discovery index
- Markdown negotiation: send `Accept: text/markdown` to `/`, `/about`, `/essays` or any essay and get the mirror back

## API

- [API catalog](https://www.mauricekleine.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset describing the endpoints below
- [maurice.json](https://www.mauricekleine.com/api/maurice.json): Bio, location, role, links
- [projects.json](https://www.mauricekleine.com/api/projects.json): Side quests and the graveyard, with statuses
- [uptime.json](https://www.mauricekleine.com/api/uptime.json): Operational status of Maurice himself
